name: HTML and CSS for Modern Websites

beginner.summary: For freshers, designers and back-end developers who need to build web pages. Covers HTML document structure, text, links, images and media, lists and tables, forms, semantic landmarks, CSS selectors and the cascade, the box model, colour and typography, Flexbox, Grid, responsive design, positioning, decoration, transitions and animations, accessibility, custom properties and theming, Bootstrap and publishing a site.
prerequisites: Comfortable using a computer, files and folders
A laptop with a modern browser and VS Code
outcomes: Write valid, semantic and accessible HTML
Style pages with modern CSS, Flexbox and Grid
Build responsive layouts that work on phones and desktops

days.topic: HTML and CSS Overview and Developer Setup
subtopics: How browsers turn HTML and CSS into pages
What HTML does and what CSS does
Installing VS Code and useful extensions
Folder structure for a website project
Validating HTML with the W3C validator
Using MDN Web Docs as a reference
days.lab_task: Set up VS Code with Live Server, create a project folder with an HTML page and a stylesheet, change text and colours with live reload, inspect elements in DevTools and validate the page.
days.deliverable: Project folder with a first page that passes validation
checks: HTML and applied CSS shown in DevTools
objectives: Explain how HTML and CSS work together
Set up a web development environment

days.topic: HTML Document Structure and Text Elements
subtopics: The doctype, html, head and body
Character encoding and the viewport meta tag
Paragraphs, line breaks and horizontal rules
Emphasis, strong, quotes and code text
days.lab_task: Mark up a two-page company profile with correct document structure, a logical heading order, paragraphs, quotes and code samples, then fix every validator warning.
checks: Headings follow a logical order with one h1 per page
Text readable without zooming thanks to the viewport tag
objectives: Use text elements for their meaning

days.topic: Links, Images and Media
subtopics: Linking to sections, email and phone numbers
Opening links in new tabs safely
Image formats: JPEG, PNG, SVG, WebP and AVIF
Embedding maps and videos with iframes
days.lab_task: Add navigation links between pages, in-page links to sections, optimised images with useful alt text, a captioned figure, a video with captions and an embedded map.
checks: No broken links across the pages
Alt text describes each image's purpose
Images under 200 KB each with no visible quality loss

days.topic: Lists and Tables
subtopics: Table structure: thead, tbody and tfoot
Merging cells with colspan and rowspan
days.lab_task: Build a price list with nested lists, a timetable table with headers, scope and a caption, and a merged-cell summary row, then explain why the page layout must not use tables.
checks: Header cells use th with scope
Table headers announced with each cell
Summary row spans the right columns

days.topic: Forms and Input Types
subtopics: The form element, action and method
Labels and why every input needs one
Text, email, number, date and tel inputs
days.lab_task: Build a registration form with labelled inputs of the right types, grouped radio buttons, built-in validation, autocomplete hints and a submit button that posts to a test endpoint.
checks: Browser blocks submission and shows messages
Email and phone inputs show suitable keyboards

days.topic: Semantic HTML and Page Landmarks
subtopics: header, nav, main, footer and aside
Choosing between div and semantic elements
Time, address and other meaningful elements
days.lab_task: Rewrite a page built only from divs into semantic HTML with landmarks, a skip link and correct buttons and links, then compare navigation with a screen reader before and after.
days.deliverable: Semantic page with before and after notes
checks: Screen reader lists header, navigation, main and footer
Keyboard users jump straight to main content
No landmark or button and link issues

days.topic: CSS Selectors, Specificity and the Cascade
subtopics: Specificity and how it is calculated
Debugging which rule wins in DevTools
days.lab_task: Style the company pages with an external stylesheet using class selectors and combinators, solve five specificity puzzles and use DevTools to explain why each winning rule wins.
checks: Winning rule predicted correctly in all five puzzles
DevTools shows the overridden and winning declarations
Stylesheet uses classes instead of ID selectors

days.topic: The Box Model, Spacing and Sizing
subtopics: Width, height, min and max sizes
CSS units: px, rem, em, percent and viewport units
days.lab_task: Build a set of cards with consistent spacing using rem units and border-box sizing, fix a margin collapsing bug, constrain content width and handle overflowing text.
checks: Box model values match the design
Gap between sections matches the design
Spacing scales with the font size

days.topic: Colours, Typography and Web Fonts
subtopics: Colour formats: hex, rgb, hsl and oklch
Font size, weight, line height and letter spacing
days.lab_task: Choose a palette that passes contrast checks, load two web fonts with fallbacks, build a type scale for headings and body text and limit line length for comfortable reading.
days.deliverable: Colour and typography styles with a contrast report
checks: Body text meets WCAG AA contrast
Page stays readable with fallback fonts
Body text lines between 45 and 80 characters

days.topic: Flexbox Layout
subtopics: Common patterns: navigation bars, cards and centring
days.lab_task: Build a navigation bar, a wrapping card row with equal heights, a centred hero section and a media object with Flexbox, and debug a broken layout with the Flexbox inspector.
checks: Cards wrap and keep equal heights
Content centred both ways at every width
Layout fixed with the cause explained

days.topic: CSS Grid Layout
days.lab_task: Build a full page layout with named grid areas, a gallery that adds columns as space grows with auto-fit and minmax, and a dashboard with items spanning rows and columns.
days.deliverable: Page layout, gallery and dashboard grids
checks: Columns added and removed without media queries
Layout changes by editing only grid-template-areas
Grid lines and areas shown in DevTools

days.topic: Responsive Design with Media Queries
subtopics: Fluid layouts with percentages and max-width
Respecting user preferences such as reduced motion
days.lab_task: Make the company site mobile first with two breakpoints, a navigation menu that collapses on small screens, fluid typography with clamp() and a reduced-motion preference.
checks: Layout works at phone, tablet and desktop widths
Menu opens and closes with mouse and keyboard
Animations stop when reduced motion is on

days.topic: Positioning, Z-Index and Stacking
subtopics: Static, relative, absolute, fixed and sticky positioning
Offsets: top, right, bottom and left
days.lab_task: Add a sticky header, a notification badge on an icon, a full-screen overlay and a sticky table header, then fix a dropdown hidden behind content by finding the stacking context.
days.deliverable: Positioned components with notes on stacking
checks: Header stays at the top without covering content
Dropdown appears above content after the fix
Stacking context that caused it identified

days.topic: Backgrounds, Borders, Shadows and Gradients
subtopics: Filters such as blur and grayscale
days.lab_task: Style a hero banner with a background image and gradient overlay that keeps text readable, rounded cards with soft shadows and buttons with hover states.
checks: Text contrast passes over the image
Clear hover and focus styles shown
Background image covers the area without distortion

days.topic: Transitions, Transforms and Animations
days.lab_task: Add smooth hover transitions to cards, an animated loading spinner, a fade-in for page sections and a reduced-motion alternative, and check that animations run at 60 frames per second.
checks: Card lifts smoothly with a transition
Animations use transform and opacity without layout work

days.topic: Accessibility Essentials for HTML and CSS
subtopics: Colour is not the only signal
Testing with axe and a screen reader
days.lab_task: Audit the company site with axe and a screen reader, fix focus styles, missing names, colour-only signals and zoom problems, and retest until no serious issues remain.
checks: Every link and control reachable with visible focus

days.topic: CSS Custom Properties and Theming
subtopics: Scope and inheritance of custom properties
Theme tokens for colours, spacing and fonts
A theme switch with a data attribute
days.lab_task: Move the site's colours, spacing and fonts into custom properties, add a dark theme that follows the system setting and a theme switch that overrides it.
checks: Every use of the colour updates across the site
Site follows the system dark setting

days.topic: Bootstrap for Rapid Layouts
subtopics: Utility classes for spacing and display
Components: navbar, cards, modals and forms
Customising Bootstrap with Sass or CSS custom properties
When to use a framework and when not to
days.lab_task: Build a landing page with the Bootstrap grid, navbar, cards, a modal and a form, customise the brand colours and remove unused CSS to cut file size.
days.deliverable: Bootstrap landing page with size comparison
checks: Bootstrap grid stacks correctly on small screens
Buttons and links use the brand palette

days.topic: Publishing a Site: Hosting, Domains and Page Speed
subtopics: Static hosting options: GitHub Pages, Netlify and Cloudflare Pages
days.lab_task: Publish the company site from GitHub to a static host with HTTPS, add favicons and sharing tags, and raise Lighthouse scores to 90 or more in every category.
checks: Social preview shows title, description and image
Scores of 90 or more in all categories

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Responsive Business Website
days.lab_task: Build and publish a five-page responsive website for a local business with semantic HTML, a contact form, Flexbox and Grid layouts, a dark theme, accessibility fixes and good Lighthouse scores, then present it.
days.deliverable: Live website, source repository and presentation
checks: All five pages work on phone and desktop
No serious axe issues on any page
HTML validates and Lighthouse scores are 90 or more
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one website

intermediate.summary: For front-end developers and designers who already build pages with HTML and CSS. Covers CSS architecture with BEM, utilities and cascade layers, advanced Grid and subgrid, container queries, modern selectors and nesting, Sass, Tailwind CSS, accessible forms and ARIA patterns, responsive images, web typography, motion with scroll-driven animations and view transitions, theming with tokens, CSS performance, SEO markup, HTML email, cross-browser testing, print styles, Figma to code and CSS tooling.
prerequisites: Builds responsive pages with Flexbox and Grid
Has published at least one website
outcomes: Structure and scale stylesheets for teams
Use modern CSS layout, selectors and motion features
Build accessible components, emails and SEO-friendly pages
Turn designs into fast, tested, cross-browser HTML and CSS

days.topic: Modern CSS Architecture: BEM, Utility Classes and Cascade Layers
subtopics: Why stylesheets become hard to maintain
Ordering resets, base, components and utilities
days.lab_task: Refactor a messy 2,000-line stylesheet into cascade layers with BEM components and a small utility set, remove every !important and write the team's CSS conventions.
checks: Utility layer overrides components without specificity hacks
Stylesheet smaller with the same visual result

days.topic: Advanced Grid: Subgrid, Named Lines and Intrinsic Layouts
subtopics: Intrinsic sizing: min-content, max-content and fit-content
days.lab_task: Build an editorial article layout with named lines and full-bleed images, product cards aligned with subgrid, and a dense image mosaic, and check that visual order matches reading order.
checks: Titles and prices line up across cards with subgrid
Images span the full width inside the article grid
Keyboard and screen reader order matches visual order

days.topic: Container Queries and Fluid Responsive Design
tools: Utopia fluid type and space calculator
days.lab_task: Build a card component that changes layout by container width, use container units for its type, place it in a sidebar, a main column and a grid, and remove the page-level breakpoints it no longer needs.
checks: Place the card in three containers
Card picks the right layout in each container
Page media queries reduced without breaking layouts
Type and spacing scale smoothly between sizes

days.topic: Modern Selectors and Nesting: :has(), :is(), :where() and Native Nesting
days.lab_task: Replace JavaScript-driven styling with :has() for form and card states, simplify selectors with :is() and :where(), style focus with :focus-visible and convert a Sass file to native nesting.
checks: Card highlights when its checkbox is checked without JavaScript
Focus ring shows for keyboard users only
Native nesting produces the same output as the Sass file

days.topic: Sass for Large Stylesheets
subtopics: Partials and the module system with @use and @forward
Compiling with Dart Sass or Vite
When native CSS replaces Sass features
days.lab_task: Organise a site's styles into Sass modules, generate spacing and colour utilities from maps, write mixins for breakpoints and compile with source maps.
days.deliverable: Sass project structure and compiled CSS
checks: Spacing utilities generated from one map
No global @import left in the project
DevTools shows the original SCSS line
objectives: Generate CSS with mixins and maps
Decide when Sass is still needed

days.topic: Tailwind CSS in Practice
subtopics: Installing Tailwind with Vite or the CLI
days.lab_task: Rebuild the landing page in Tailwind with the brand theme, responsive and dark variants and extracted components, and compare build size and development time with the hand-written version.
days.deliverable: Tailwind version with a comparison note
checks: Brand colours and fonts come from the theme
Layout, hover and dark styles work from utility classes
Production CSS size recorded for both versions

days.topic: Accessible Forms and Custom Controls
subtopics: Custom checkboxes and radios with real inputs underneath
Testing forms with keyboard and screen readers
days.lab_task: Rebuild a checkout form with linked hints and errors, an error summary, custom-styled checkboxes and radios that keep native inputs, and test it with a keyboard and screen reader.
checks: Error summary appears and links to each field
Screen reader announces label, hint and error
Styled checkboxes work with keyboard and screen reader

days.topic: Accessible Components with ARIA Patterns
subtopics: Modal dialogs with the dialog element
Using the ARIA Authoring Practices Guide
days.lab_task: Build an accordion, tabs, a navigation menu button and a modal dialog following the ARIA Authoring Practices Guide, with full keyboard support and screen reader testing.
checks: Arrow keys move between tabs as the pattern describes
Focus moves into the dialog and returns on close

days.topic: Responsive Images and Art Direction
subtopics: Width and height to prevent layout shift
days.lab_task: Serve hero and product images with srcset, sizes and picture for art direction, provide AVIF and WebP with fallbacks, lazy-load below-the-fold images and remove layout shift.
checks: Smaller image file served on small screens
Below-the-fold images load only when scrolled near

days.topic: Web Typography in Depth: Font Loading and Fluid Type
subtopics: Font metrics overrides to reduce layout shift
days.lab_task: Subset and self-host the brand fonts, preload the critical one, build a fluid type scale, balance headline wrapping and remove font-swap layout shift with metric overrides.
checks: No layout shift when fonts swap

days.topic: Motion Design with CSS: Keyframes, Scroll-Driven Animations and View Transitions
subtopics: Scroll-driven animations with scroll and view timelines
View transitions for page and state changes
days.lab_task: Add a reading progress bar with a scroll timeline, reveal sections as they enter view, animate page changes with view transitions and provide reduced-motion and unsupported-browser fallbacks.
checks: Progress bar follows scroll position without JavaScript
objectives: Use scroll-driven animations and view transitions

days.topic: Theming and Dark Mode with Design Tokens
subtopics: Brand themes from one token set
days.lab_task: Build primitive and semantic token files, generate light, dark and high-contrast themes, support forced colours mode and test contrast in every theme.
checks: All components restyle from tokens only
Every theme meets WCAG AA for text
Controls stay visible in Windows high contrast

days.topic: CSS Performance: Critical CSS, Containment and Rendering Cost
tools: Chrome DevTools Performance and Coverage panels
days.lab_task: Measure a slow page, inline critical CSS, defer the rest, remove unused rules, apply content-visibility to long sections and record before and after metrics.
checks: Rendering time for the long page drops

days.topic: SEO-Friendly HTML: Metadata, Structured Data and Open Graph
subtopics: Headings and content structure for search
Image alt text and file names for search
Checking with Search Console and validators
days.lab_task: Add titles, descriptions, canonical links, JSON-LD for organisation, articles and products, social cards and a sitemap to the site, and validate rich results.
checks: Social card shows the right title and image

days.topic: HTML Email Development
subtopics: Images, alt text and accessibility in email
days.lab_task: Build a responsive order confirmation email with MJML, check rendering in Gmail, Outlook and Apple Mail, support dark mode and keep it accessible with images turned off.
checks: Email looks correct in Gmail, Outlook and Apple Mail
Message still readable with alt text
Colours stay readable in dark mode

days.topic: Cross-Browser Testing and Progressive Enhancement
subtopics: Testing on real devices and cloud browsers
days.lab_task: Test the site in Chrome, Firefox, Safari and a mobile browser, fix three engine-specific bugs, add fallbacks for two new features and write a browser support policy.
days.deliverable: Test matrix, fixes and support policy
checks: Pages work in every browser in the matrix
Older browsers get a working fallback
Supported browsers and the reason for each listed

days.topic: Print Styles and PDF Output
subtopics: Hiding navigation and showing link URLs
Headers and footers in printed output
days.lab_task: Write print styles for an invoice and a report page with clean page breaks, repeated table headers and page numbers, and generate PDFs from the HTML.
checks: Navigation hidden and content fits the page
Table headers repeat on each page

days.topic: Converting Figma Designs to HTML and CSS
subtopics: Reading a design: grids, spacing and type
Inspecting values in Figma Dev Mode
Translating auto layout into Flexbox and Grid
Handling states the design does not show
Reviewing the build with the designer
days.lab_task: Build a three-page site from a Figma file, translate auto layout into Flexbox and Grid, export assets, add missing states and review the result against the design with a designer.
days.deliverable: Built pages and a design review log
checks: Spacing and type match the design within agreed tolerance
Hover, focus, empty and error states built
objectives: Map design tools to CSS layout

days.topic: Linting, Formatting and Build Tools for CSS: Stylelint, PostCSS and Vite
days.lab_task: Add Stylelint, Prettier, PostCSS and a Vite build to the site, run HTML validation and linting in GitHub Actions and block commits that break the rules.
checks: No lint errors in the stylesheets
Validation, lint and build pass in GitHub Actions
objectives: Lint and format HTML and CSS

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Accessible Multi-Page Marketing Site
days.lab_task: Build a marketing site from a Figma design with layered CSS architecture, container-query components, light and dark themes, accessible forms, motion, SEO markup, print styles and a CI pipeline, then launch it.
days.deliverable: Live site, repository and quality reports
checks: Pages match the design across devices
No serious axe issues and keyboard flows work
CI runs lint, validation and Lighthouse checks
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one site

advanced.summary: For senior front-end developers, UI engineers and design system teams. Covers the browser rendering pipeline, CSS architecture for many teams, design tokens across platforms, web components and shadow DOM styling, logical properties and right-to-left layouts, WCAG 2.2 audits, animation and the compositor, Core Web Vitals, fluid design systems, dialogs, popovers and anchor positioning, visual regression testing, legacy CSS migration, styling approaches, multi-brand theming, CSS security, SVG, front-end tooling, quality leadership and a multi-brand design system.
prerequisites: Several years building production front ends
Strong knowledge of modern CSS and accessibility
Works with a design system or component library
outcomes: Explain and optimise how browsers render HTML and CSS
Architect CSS and tokens for many teams and brands
Lead accessibility, performance and visual quality programmes
Build and govern a multi-brand design system

days.topic: How Browsers Render: Parsing, Style, Layout, Paint and Composite
days.lab_task: Trace a slow page through parsing, style, layout, paint and composite, find the costliest stage, fix forced reflows and excessive paint areas and prove the gains.
checks: Main cost identified in the flame chart
No forced reflow warnings after the fix
Paint areas smaller with paint flashing

days.topic: CSS Architecture for Large Teams and Design Systems
days.lab_task: Assess the CSS of a large product, design a layer and ownership model, remove dead CSS safely with coverage data and record the architecture decisions.
days.deliverable: CSS architecture proposal and clean-up results
checks: Unused rules removed with no visual change

days.topic: Design Tokens Across Platforms
subtopics: Token tiers: primitive, semantic and component
Generating CSS, iOS and Android outputs
days.lab_task: Build a token pipeline from a W3C-format token file to CSS, iOS and Android outputs, sync with Figma variables and ship a versioned token change with visual tests.
checks: CSS, iOS and Android files generated from one source
Figma variables match the token source

days.topic: Web Components and Shadow DOM Styling
subtopics: Styling from outside with custom properties and ::part
days.lab_task: Build a button, input and card as web components with shadow DOM, theme them from outside with custom properties and parts, and use them in a React and a plain HTML page.
days.deliverable: Web component set with theming guide
checks: Components restyle through custom properties and parts
Components work inside a React app

days.topic: Internationalisation in CSS: Logical Properties, Writing Modes and RTL Layouts
days.lab_task: Convert a site to logical properties, support Arabic right-to-left layout and a vertical Japanese headline, test with pseudo-localised long text and fix overflow problems.
checks: Layout mirrors correctly with dir set to rtl
No physical left or right properties left in components

days.topic: Accessibility Engineering: WCAG 2.2 Audits and Remediation
subtopics: Audit methods: automated, manual and assistive technology
Working with disabled users in testing
days.lab_task: Run a full WCAG 2.2 AA audit of a product flow, write a report with severities, fix the top issues and add automated accessibility tests to prevent regressions.
days.deliverable: Audit report, fixes and regression tests
checks: CI fails when an accessibility test breaks

days.topic: Animation Performance and the Compositor
subtopics: Which properties trigger layout, paint or composite
Animating with the Web Animations API
tools: Chrome DevTools Performance and Layers panels
days.lab_task: Fix a janky carousel and a sticky header animation on a throttled CPU by moving work to the compositor, measure layer memory and set motion budgets.
checks: Frames hold at 60 per second on a 4x throttled CPU
objectives: Keep motion smooth on slow devices

days.topic: Core Web Vitals Engineering for HTML and CSS
subtopics: Largest Contentful Paint and its parts
Interaction to Next Paint and styling work
Resource hints: preload, preconnect and fetchpriority
Field data from CrUX and RUM
days.lab_task: Improve a slow landing page's LCP, CLS and INP using HTML and CSS changes only, confirm with lab and field data and add Lighthouse CI budgets.
checks: LCP below 2.5 seconds in lab tests
Lighthouse CI fails when budgets are exceeded

days.topic: Fluid Design Systems: clamp(), Container Units and Type Scales
subtopics: Minimum and maximum bounds for accessibility
days.lab_task: Replace fixed breakpoints in a design system with fluid type and space scales, use container units in components, check zoom accessibility and publish the fluid tokens.
checks: Type and spacing scale without jumps
Fluid tokens available to all components

days.topic: Native UI Patterns: Dialogs, Popovers and Anchor Positioning
subtopics: The dialog element and modal behaviour
Anchor positioning for tooltips and menus
days.lab_task: Replace a JavaScript tooltip, dropdown and modal with dialog, popover and anchor positioning, add fallbacks for unsupported browsers and measure the JavaScript removed.
checks: Popover opens in the top layer and closes on outside click
Tooltip follows its anchor and flips at the viewport edge

days.topic: Visual Regression Testing for CSS
subtopics: Why CSS changes break things silently
Handling fonts, animations and dynamic data
days.lab_task: Add visual regression tests for components across themes and three breakpoints, make them stable, run them in CI and approve one intentional change.
days.deliverable: Visual test suite and review workflow
checks: Unintended spacing change fails the test
Ten repeated runs pass without flakes
Intentional change approved and baseline updated

days.topic: Refactoring and Migrating Legacy Stylesheets
subtopics: Moving from Bootstrap 3 or 4 to modern CSS
Wrapping legacy CSS in a layer
Visual tests as a safety net
days.lab_task: Migrate a page from Bootstrap 3 and float layouts to modern Grid and Flexbox with legacy styles wrapped in a layer, protected by visual tests, and plan the remaining migration.
checks: Legacy rules no longer override new components
Page matches the old design with modern layout
Plan lists pages, risks and order
objectives: Use layers to contain old styles

days.topic: Styling Approaches: CSS Modules, CSS-in-JS and Zero-Runtime Options
subtopics: Global CSS, CSS Modules and scoped styles
Choosing an approach for a product
days.lab_task: Build the same component in CSS Modules, a runtime CSS-in-JS library and a zero-runtime library, measure bundle and runtime costs and recommend an approach.
checks: Recommendation covers performance, team skills and tooling
objectives: Choose an approach for a product

days.topic: Multi-Brand and White-Label Theming
subtopics: Brand layers on top of shared tokens
days.lab_task: Add two brands to a shared design system with brand token layers, runtime switching, brand fonts and assets, and test all brands for contrast and visual regressions.
checks: Visual tests run for each brand

days.topic: Security in HTML and CSS: CSP, Sanitisation and CSS Injection
subtopics: Content Security Policy for styles and scripts
Safe use of target and rel attributes
days.lab_task: Find and fix planted issues: unsanitised user HTML, a CSS injection that leaks data, missing frame protection and unpinned CDN files, then apply a strict CSP.
checks: Injected selector no longer leaks values
Strict CSP active with no violations in normal use

days.topic: SVG in Depth: Icons, Illustrations and Animation
subtopics: Accessible SVG with titles and roles
Styling SVG with CSS and currentColor
days.lab_task: Build an accessible icon system with a sprite and currentColor, optimise a set of illustrations, animate a line drawing with stroke offsets and make an illustration responsive.
checks: Icons follow text colour with currentColor
SVG file sizes reduced with no visual change
Meaningful icons announced and decorative ones hidden

days.topic: Accessible Data Visualisation with HTML, SVG and CSS
subtopics: Choosing chart types for the message
Building simple charts with HTML, CSS and SVG
Colour palettes that work for colour blindness
Patterns and labels instead of colour alone
Text alternatives and data tables for charts
Keyboard and screen reader access to chart data
Testing charts with users of assistive technology
days.lab_task: Build a bar chart and a line chart with SVG and CSS, add direct labels and patterns, provide data tables and descriptions, make them responsive and test them with a screen reader and colour blindness simulation.
days.deliverable: Accessible charts with a test report
checks: Chart description and data table announced
Charts stay readable on a phone

days.topic: Front-End Tooling: Lightning CSS, PostCSS Plugins and Build Pipelines
subtopics: Linting rules for a design system
days.lab_task: Compare Lightning CSS and PostCSS on a large stylesheet, write a PostCSS plugin that enforces token use, set browser targets and split CSS per route.
days.deliverable: Build pipeline with a custom plugin
checks: Build time and output size compared
Plugin fails the build on hard-coded colours
Each route loads only its CSS

days.topic: Leading Front-End Quality: Standards, Reviews and Style Guides
subtopics: Front-end standards for HTML and CSS
Quality metrics: accessibility, performance and visual stability
Working with design and product teams
days.lab_task: Write HTML and CSS standards and a review checklist, set up a living style guide, define quality metrics and present a quarterly quality report.
checks: Standards reviewed by developers and designers
Two pull requests reviewed with the checklist

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Multi-Brand Design System in HTML and CSS
days.lab_task: Build a multi-brand design system with cross-platform tokens, fluid scales, web components, native popovers and dialogs, right-to-left support, WCAG 2.2 compliance and visual and performance tests, then defend it to a review panel.
days.deliverable: Design system repository, documentation and defence
checks: WCAG 2.2 AA audit passes for all components
Visual and performance tests pass in CI for every brand
Review panel questions answered with evidence
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one system
